title: Create the V4 package authority skeleton and checker
goal: Create schema-valid plugin/profile/module authorities and a fail-closed package checker while preserving P0 host compatibility and excluding mutable V4 data from package identity.
acceptanceCriteria: plugin.json plus default and synthetic profiles validate against the frozen contracts.
The synthetic module uses the v1 module contract and hash-binds its adapter and dependency lock.
Package checking rejects unknown fields, duplicate IDs, catalog path escape, raw profile executables, undeclared modules, TargetRoot writes and hash drift.
An empty package with only the default profile validates.
V4 mutable state and work roots are ignored and do not affect the computed package hash.
P0 and current V3 validation remain green with no active workflow or remote change.
